purpose: Workflow interpolates an issue title into a shell line

groundTruth.rationale: Issue titles are written by whoever opens the issue, and the runner expands the expression before the shell parses the line.

limitations: Line-level lexical detection only; the rule is a review prompt, not proof of exploitability or attacker control.
The fixture is synthetic and asserts nothing about any real repository.

provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence
